title: Professional Services Projects Expense and Payment Terms Table
content:
The accounts receivable terms of Professional Services Projects cover pass-through expenses, payment terms, late fees, the work stoppage threshold and card payments, each set by engagement class.

| Figure | Assessment Engagement | Quick Start Project | Standard Project | Advanced Project | Major Project | Strategic Program |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Markup on pass-through expenses other than mileage (percent) | 10 | 10 | 10 | 8 | 8 | 5 |
| Distance from the nearest Stratton Bay office within which travel is not billed (miles) | 50 | 50 | 50 | 50 | 50 | 50 |
| Rate per mile for billable round-trip mileage beyond the included radius (USD per mile) | 0.70 | 0.70 | 0.70 | 0.70 | 0.70 | 0.70 |
| Single expense above which the authorized contact's written pre-approval is needed (USD) | 250.00 | 250.00 | 500.00 | 1000.00 | 2500.00 | 5000.00 |
| Net payment terms from the invoice posted date (calendar days) | 15 | 15 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 45 |
| Monthly late fee on an invoice's unpaid balance past the grace period (percent) | 1.5 | 1.5 | 1.5 | 1.5 | 1.5 | 1.5 |
| Calendar days after the due date before a late fee is assessed | 5 | 5 | 5 | 10 | 10 | 15 |
| Minimum late fee per invoice per month (USD) | 25.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 | 35.00 | 50.00 | 50.00 |
| Days an engagement invoice may be past due before work is put on hold for non-payment | 15 | 15 | 30 | 30 | 45 | 45 |
| Largest invoice that may be paid by card (USD) | 5000.00 | 5000.00 | 10000.00 | 10000.00 | 10000.00 | 10000.00 |

## Reading the table

- Mileage carries no markup; the markup row applies to the other pass-through expenses.
- Each figure is the figure of the engagement the invoice or expense belongs to.

Hypothetical illustration: a Standard Project invoice posted on the first day of a month falls due 30 calendar days later; a single expense of 600.00 on that engagement is above the 500.00 pre-approval figure.
